include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/generated.rs"));

#[cfg(feature = "alternate")]
type FeatureError = std::io::Error;
#[cfg(not(feature = "alternate"))]
type FeatureError = std::num::ParseIntError;

pub fn generated() -> Result<u32, GeneratedError> { Ok(7) }
pub fn feature_contract() -> Result<(), FeatureError> { Ok(()) }
#[cfg(build_ready)]
pub fn from_build_cfg() -> u32 { 9 }

context_macros::fallible!();
pub fn macro_call() { let _ = macro_leaf(); }
pub fn dependency_call() { let _ = context_dependency::leaf(); }
